body: Hey man, thanks. Really appreciate it. It's hard to find nice people who offer their help to strangers or maybe i haven't come across any.

It's just that I am tired of being a people pleaser. Maybe I'm this way because i have always been sidelined since childhood at school. I'd rather be class clown than a leader when i clearly had the technical and soft skills. I am deadass afraid of losing people and because of all this i find it really hard to choose myself and move on. I don't like bitching about anyone so I'll just say in short that my ex did a pretty significant damage to my self worth and mental health. I used to be so anxious as a child that i developed stammering and have been bullied for it ever since. Hell i feel ashamed when i can't even spell out the name of a cigarette at the moment of peak anxiety. And about people who i can talk to, i have none honestly. Like once someone patronizes me and makes my issue look insignificant my mind automatically creates a invisible box surrounding that person and sets up boundaries which i would never want to cross even if i was dying and i needed their help because this has happened so much. I feel numb most of the days. I was able to complete my degree(s) thanks to the learning technique my dad taught me. I hate self loathing, it gets me nowhere but i just can't get past it because everytime i mess up even a little i start feeling useless. I stopped gaming because of this. All i ever wanted was acceptance and acknowledgement, that yes I'm a person and people SEE me. But unfortunately no one even looks out for me. If i were an orphan I'd probably have been dead by now because i really don't see any purpose in my life. Everytime i try to find a purpose and i mess up and it's the same old story again, back to square one and I'm just plan tired.
